semantics: Side A fixed from own generated match reports 4562 and 4565.
Only strictly earlier observed COMMS snapshots supply candidate wells.
No map truth or other-team observation is treated as our knowledge.
Replay trip well is the dominant collected well; reconstructed deposit load is all resources, not necessarily the dominant well resource alone. Per-trip deposit HQ is absent without dots.
Opportunity geometry is not exact counterfactual call count: shared state between snapshots, current role/well changes after TRIP, private seen wells, movement, and budget are not fully observed.
Zero opportunity counts do not rule out unobserved newly published or privately seen wells.
